cards.en: The grave is a garden of the gardens of Paradise, or a pit of the pits of the Fire.

cards.ask: Which word completes the line?
cards.ar: والقبر ____ من رياض الجنة أو حفرة من حفر النيران
options: روضة
مدينة
سماء
cards.source: والقبر روضة من رياض الجنة أو حفرة من حفر النيران
cards.why: روضة: a garden of the gardens of Paradise.

cards.ask: Who questions the buried, in the creed?
options: Munkar and Nakir
The Noble Scribes
The Angel of Death
cards.source: وسؤال منكر ونكير في قبره
cards.why: Munkar and Nakir question him in his grave.

cards.ask: Someone says: "There is no punishment in the grave; it begins on the Last Day." What does the creed say?
options: The grave's torment is real for those who earn it
He is right: the grave is rest for good and bad
He is right: the dead feel neither good nor ill until the Rising
cards.source: وبعذاب القبر لمن كان له أهلا
cards.why: We believe in the punishment of the grave for whoever deserves it; the grave is a garden of Paradise or a pit of the Fire.

lessons.title: The Rising, Paradise and the Fire

cards.title: The Day of Rising
cards.ar: ونؤمن بالبعث وجزاء الأعمال يوم القيامة والعرض والحساب وقراءة الكتاب والثواب والعقاب والصراط والميزان
cards.en: We believe in the Resurrection and the repaying of deeds on the Day of Rising: the Showing, the Reckoning, the reading of the Book, the reward and punishment, the Bridge (Sirat) and the Scale (Mizan).

cards.ask: Which of these are listed for the Day of Rising?

options.text: A second life in this world

cards.source: والعرض والحساب وقراءة الكتاب والثواب والعقاب والصراط والميزان
cards.why: Al-'ard, al-hisab, the Book read, reward and punishment, the Sirat and the Mizan.

cards.ask: In the list for the Day of Rising, which is the Mizan?
options: The Scale
The Bridge
The Pool
cards.source: والصراط والميزان
cards.why: The Sirat is the Bridge; the Mizan is the Scale.

cards.title: Created, and never ending
cards.ar: والجنة والنار مخلوقتان لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.en: Paradise and the Fire are created, and they will never come to an end or pass away.

cards.title: Created with their people
cards.ar: وإن الله تعالى خلق الجنة والنار قبل الخلق وخلق لهما أهلا فمن شاء منهم إلى الجنة فضلا منه ومن شاء منهم إلى النار عدلا منه
cards.en: Allah created Paradise and the Fire before creation, and created people for each. Whom He wills goes to Paradise, out of His grace; whom He wills goes to the Fire, out of His justice.

cards.ask: Someone says Paradise and the Fire do not exist yet and will one day end. What does the creed say?
options: Both already exist and will last for ever
He is right: they will be made on the Last Day
He is right that the Fire will one day end
cards.source: والجنة والنار مخلوقتان لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.why: Makhluqatan, la tafniyan: they are created, and never end; Allah created them before creation.

cards.ask: Fill the gap in the creed's words.
cards.ar: والجنة والنار ____ لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
options: مخلوقتان
فانيتان
غائبتان
cards.source: والجنة والنار مخلوقتان لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.why: مخلوقتان: both are created.

cards.title: Each works towards it
cards.ar: وكل يعمل لما قد فرغ له وصائر إلى ما خلق له
cards.en: Each one works towards what has been settled for him, and is headed to what he was created for.

cards.title: Good and evil decreed
cards.ar: والخير والشر مقدران على العباد
cards.en: Good and evil are both decreed for servants.

cards.ask: Someone says: "Allah decrees the good; evil is the servant's own creation." What does the creed say?
options: Allah has measured out good and bad alike
He is right: evil comes from the servant
Both are decreed, so the servant has no part in his deeds
cards.source: والخير والشر مقدران على العباد
cards.why: Good and evil are both decreed for servants; yet servants' acts are also their acquiring (kasb), as the next lesson says.

cards.title: Capacity with the deed
cards.ar: والاستطاعة التي يجب بها الفعل من نحو التوفيق الذي لا يجوز أن يوصف المخلوق به فهي مع الفعل
cards.en: Capacity (istita'a) is of two kinds. The capacity by which a deed actually happens, of the kind of divine enabling (tawfiq), which no creature can be described as having, comes with the deed.

cards.title: Capacity before the deed
cards.ar: وأما الاستطاعة من جهة الصحة والوسع والتمكن وسلامة الآلات فهي قبل الفعل وبها يتعلق الخطاب
cards.en: The capacity of health, means, ability and sound limbs comes before the deed, and it is what Allah's command (khitab) is tied to.

cards.ask: How many kinds of capacity (istita'a) are described?
options: Two
Three
One
source: والاستطاعة التي يجب بها الفعل
وأما الاستطاعة من جهة الصحة
cards.why: One that comes with the deed, and one that comes before it.

cards.ask: Sort: which capacity comes with the deed, and which before it?
source: من نحو التوفيق الذي لا يجوز أن يوصف المخلوق به فهي مع الفعل
من جهة الصحة والوسع والتمكن وسلامة الآلات فهي قبل الفعل
cards.why: The tawfiq kind comes with the deed; health, means, ability and sound limbs come before it.

cards.title: No soul beyond its capacity
cards.ar: وهو كما قال تعالى لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها
cards.en: It is as Allah says: "Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity" (2:286).

cards.title: Created and acquired
cards.ar: وأفعال العباد خلق الله وكسب من العباد
cards.en: The acts of servants are Allah's creation, and the servants' acquiring (kasb).

cards.ask: Complete the statement.
cards.ar: وأفعال العباد خلق الله و____ من العباد
options: كسب
علم
ذكر
cards.source: وأفعال العباد خلق الله وكسب من العباد
cards.why: كسب: the acts are Allah's creation and the servants' acquiring.

cards.title: Only what they can bear
cards.ar: ولم يكلفهم الله تعالى إلا ما يطيقون ولا يطيقون إلا ما كلفهم
cards.en: Allah has charged them only with what they can bear, and they can bear only what He has charged them with.

cards.title: No power except by Allah
cards.ar: وهو تفسير لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
cards.en: That is the meaning of "There is no power and no strength except by Allah" (la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah).

cards.ask: A sick man cannot stand for prayer. What has Allah charged him with, by the creed?
options: What lies within his ability
Standing as usual, as a test of him
Standing all the same, or his prayer is not accepted
source: ولم يكلفهم الله تعالى إلا ما يطيقون ولا يطيقون إلا ما كلفهم
وهو كما قال تعالى لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها
cards.why: Allah has charged them only with what they can bear: "Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity".

cards.title: No turning from sin but by His help
cards.ar: نقول لا حيلة لأحد ولا حركة لأحد ولا تحول لأحد عن معصية الله إلا بمعونة الله
cards.en: We say: no one has any means, any movement or any turning away from disobeying Allah, except by Allah's help.

cards.title: No strength for obedience but by His enabling
cards.ar: ولا قوة لأحد على إقامة طاعة الله والثبات عليها إلا بتوفيق الله
cards.en: And no one has strength to do what Allah commands and stay firm on it, except by Allah's enabling (tawfiq).

cards.ask: Which of these does the creed say here?

options.text: Allah charges people only with what they can bear
No one turns from sin except by Allah's help
No one stays firm in obedience except by Allah's enabling
Allah charges people with more than they can bear
People can obey by their own strength alone

source: ولم يكلفهم الله تعالى إلا ما يطيقون
ولا تحول لأحد عن معصية الله إلا بمعونة الله
والثبات عليها إلا بتوفيق الله
cards.why: This is the meaning of la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

lessons.title: His will, du'a and His pleasure

cards.title: His will overcomes all
cards.ar: وكل شيء يجري بمشيئة الله تعالى وعلمه وقضائه وقدره غلبت مشيئة المشيئات كلها وغلب قضاؤه الحيل كلها
cards.en: Everything runs by Allah's will, knowledge, decree and measure. His will overcomes all wills, and His decree overcomes all schemes.

cards.title: Never unjust
cards.ar: يفعل ما يشاء وهو غير ظالم أبدا تقدس عن كل سوء وحين وتنزه عن كل عيب وشين
cards.en: He does what He wills, and He is never unjust. He is holy above every evil and ruin, and far above every fault and flaw.

cards.ask: Someone says: "If Allah wills everything, He wrongs those He punishes." Which line of the creed answers him?
options: He acts as He wills, and injustice is not of Him
The du'a and charity of the living benefit the dead
Allah answers prayers and fulfils needs
cards.source: يفعل ما يشاء وهو غير ظالم أبدا
cards.why: Yaf'alu ma yasha' wa huwa ghayru zalim: He does what He wills, and is never unjust.

cards.title: The living help the dead
cards.ar: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
cards.en: The du'a of the living and their charity bring benefit to the dead.

cards.title: He answers
cards.ar: والله تعالى يستجيب الدعوات ويقضي الحاجات
cards.en: Allah answers prayers and fulfils needs.

cards.ask: What benefits the dead?
cards.source: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
cards.why: Du'a and sadaqa from the living benefit the dead.

cards.ask: Which word belongs in the gap?
cards.ar: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم ____ للأموات
options: منفعة
مضرة
حسرة
cards.source: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
cards.why: منفعة: they bring benefit to the dead.

cards.title: He owns everything
cards.ar: ويملك كل شيء ولا يملكه شيء ولا غنى عن الله تعالى طرفة عين
cards.en: He owns everything, and nothing owns Him. No one can do without Allah for the blink of an eye.

cards.title: Whoever thinks himself free of Him
cards.ar: ومن استغنى عن الله طرفة عين فقد كفر وصار من أهل الحين
cards.en: Whoever thinks himself free of need of Allah for the blink of an eye has disbelieved and become one of the ruined.

cards.ask: A man feels his health and wealth make him independent of Allah. What does the creed say?
options: Thinking so, even for an instant, is kufr
He may be, for as long as his health and wealth last
He may be, for a day or two
source: ويملك كل شيء ولا يملكه شيء ولا غنى عن الله تعالى طرفة عين
ومن استغنى عن الله طرفة عين فقد كفر وصار من أهل الحين
cards.why: No one can do without Allah for the blink of an eye; whoever thinks himself free of Him for that long has disbelieved.

cards.title: Angered and pleased
cards.ar: والله يغضب ويرضى لا كأحد من الورى
cards.en: Allah is angered and is pleased, not like anyone of creation.

cards.ask: How is Allah angered and pleased, in the creed?
options: In a way unlike any creature
Just as people are
He is neither, as that would be change in Him
cards.source: والله يغضب ويرضى لا كأحد من الورى
cards.why: Yaghdabu wa yarda, la ka-ahadin min al-wara: not like anyone of creation.

cards.ask: Sort: what the creed affirms, and what it rejects.
items: Du'a of the living benefits the dead
Allah is pleased as a creature is
source: وهو غير ظالم أبدا
وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
ولا يملكه شيء
والله تعالى يستجيب الدعوات
لا كأحد من الورى
cards.why: He is never unjust and nothing owns Him; du'a helps the dead, He answers prayers, and His pleasure is not like a creature's.

parts.title: The Companions, the awliya and the Jama'a

cards.title: We love them all
cards.ar: ونحب أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا نفرط في حب أحد منهم ولا نتبرأ من أحد منهم
cards.en: We love the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We do not go to excess in loving any one of them, nor disown any one of them.

cards.title: Only good
cards.ar: ونبغض من يبغضهم وبغير الخير يذكرهم ولا نذكرهم إلا بخير
cards.en: We dislike whoever dislikes them or speaks of them other than well, and we speak of them only well.

cards.ask: Which of these do we do towards the Companions?

options.text: Go to excess in loving one of them

source: ونحب أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا نفرط في حب أحد منهم ولا نتبرأ من أحد منهم
ولا نذكرهم إلا بخير
cards.why: We love them and speak only well of them, without excess for one or disowning another.

cards.title: Love of them is religion
cards.ar: وحبهم دين وإيمان وإحسان وبغضهم كفر ونفاق وطغيان
cards.en: Loving them is religion, iman and ihsan; hating them is disbelief, hypocrisy and transgression.

cards.ask: Sort: what loving them is, and what hating them is.
cards.source: وحبهم دين وإيمان وإحسان وبغضهم كفر ونفاق وطغيان
cards.why: Love: din, iman, ihsan. Hate: kufr, nifaq, tughyan.

cards.ask: Which word completes the line?
cards.ar: وحبهم دين وإيمان و____
options: إحسان
نفاق
طغيان
cards.source: وحبهم دين وإيمان وإحسان
cards.why: إحسان: loving them is religion, iman and ihsan.

cards.ask: Someone loves Ali greatly but disowns Abu Bakr and Umar. What does the creed say?
options: We love them all, without excess, disowning none
That is fine: love of the Prophet's household is enough
That is fine: one may choose among them
cards.source: ولا نفرط في حب أحد منهم ولا نتبرأ من أحد منهم
cards.why: We love the Companions, without excess in love for any of them, and disown none of them.

cards.ask: How should a Muslim speak of the Companions?
options: With good, and good alone
As he pleases
Of their faults, to be fair
cards.source: ولا نذكرهم إلا بخير
cards.why: La nadhkuruhum illa bi-khayr: only well.

cards.title: Abu Bakr first
cards.ar: ونثبت الخلافة بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أولا لأبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه تفضيلا له وتقديما على جميع الأمة
cards.en: We affirm the caliphate after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ first for Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, preferring him and putting him before the whole umma.

cards.title: Then Umar, Uthman, Ali
cards.ar: ثم لعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه ثم لعثمان رضي الله عنه ثم لعلي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه وهم الخلفاء الراشدون والأئمة المهتدون
cards.en: Then for Umar ibn al-Khattab, then Uthman, then Ali ibn Abi Talib. They are the Rightly-Guided Caliphs (al-khulafa' al-rashidun) and the guided imams.

cards.ask: Put the caliphs in the order the text gives.
source: أولا لأبي بكر الصديق
ثم لعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه ثم لعثمان رضي الله عنه ثم لعلي بن أبي طالب
cards.why: Abu Bakr first, then Umar, then Uthman, then Ali.

cards.ask: Who held the caliphate first after the Messenger ﷺ?
options: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq
Ali ibn Abi Talib
Umar ibn al-Khattab
cards.source: ونثبت الخلافة بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أولا لأبي بكر الصديق
cards.why: Awwalan li-Abi Bakr: first for Abu Bakr al-Siddiq.

cards.title: The Ten given glad news
cards.ar: وأن العشرة الذين سماهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وبشرهم بالجنة نشهد لهم بالجنة على ما شهد لهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وقوله الحق
cards.en: The Ten whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ named and gave the glad news of Paradise: we testify that they are in Paradise, as he testified for them, and his word is truth.

cards.title: Their names
cards.ar: وهم أبو بكر وعمر وعثمان علي وطلحة والزبير وسعد وسعيد وعبد الرحمن بن عوف وأبو عبيدة الجراح وهو أمين هذه الأمة
cards.en: They are Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Talha, al-Zubayr, Sa'd, Sa'id, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, and Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah, the trustee of this umma.

cards.ask: Which of these are among the Ten named here?
cards.source: وطلحة والزبير وسعد وسعيد وعبد الرحمن بن عوف وأبو عبيدة الجراح
cards.why: All four are in his list of the Ten; Bilal and Khalid are not in it.

cards.ask: Who is called the trustee (amin) of this umma?
options: Abu Ubayda
Abu Bakr al-Siddiq
Talha
cards.source: وأبو عبيدة الجراح وهو أمين هذه الأمة
cards.why: Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah: amin hadhihi al-umma.

cards.title: Free of hypocrisy
cards.ar: ومن أحسن القول في أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأزواجه الطاهرات من كل دنس وذرياته المقدسين من كل رجس فقد برئ من النفاق
cards.en: Whoever speaks well of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, of his wives, pure of every stain, and of his offspring, sanctified from every filth, is free of hypocrisy.

cards.ask: Someone praises the Companions but speaks ill of the Prophet's wives. Is he free of hypocrisy, by the creed?
options: No: the wives and offspring must be spoken of well too
Yes: praising the Companions alone is quite enough for that
Yes: the wives are not part of what is meant here
cards.source: ومن أحسن القول في أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأزواجه الطاهرات من كل دنس وذرياته المقدسين من كل رجس فقد برئ من النفاق
cards.why: Whoever speaks well of the Companions, his wives and his offspring is free of hypocrisy: all three.

cards.title: The scholars of the salaf
cards.ar: وعلماء السلف من السابقين ومن بعدهم من التابعين أهل الخير والأثر وأهل الفقه والنظر لا يذكرون إلا بالجميل
cards.en: The scholars of the early generations (salaf), the first ones and the Successors (tabi'in) after them, people of good and of reports, people of fiqh and reasoning, are spoken of only with what is beautiful.

cards.title: Speaking ill of them
cards.ar: ومن ذكرهم بسوء فهو على غير السبيل
cards.en: Whoever speaks ill of them is off the path.

cards.ask: A student mocks one of the early fuqaha for his reasoning. What does the creed say?
options: He has strayed; they are mentioned with honour
He is free to, since they were not prophets
He is right to do so, if that faqih erred in a ruling
source: وعلماء السلف من السابقين ومن بعدهم من التابعين أهل الخير والأثر وأهل الفقه والنظر لا يذكرون إلا بالجميل
ومن ذكرهم بسوء فهو على غير السبيل
cards.why: The scholars of the salaf, people of fiqh and reasoning, are spoken of only with what is beautiful; whoever speaks ill of them is off the path.

cards.title: No wali above a prophet
cards.ar: ولا نفضل أحدا من الأولياء على أحد من الأنبياء عليهم السلام
cards.en: We do not prefer any of the awliya (friends of Allah) over any of the prophets.

cards.title: One prophet is better
cards.ar: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع الأولياء
cards.en: We say: a single prophet is better than all the awliya together.

cards.ask: Fill the gap in the creed's words.
cards.ar: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع ____
options: الأولياء
الأنبياء
الرسل
cards.source: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع الأولياء
cards.why: الأولياء: one prophet is better than all the awliya.

cards.title: Their wonders
cards.ar: ونؤمن بما جاء من كراماتهم وصح عن الثقات من رواياتهم
cards.en: We believe in what has come of their wonders (karamat), soundly reported by trustworthy narrators.

cards.ask: Someone says his shaykh, a great wali, is better than a prophet. What does the creed say?
options: A single prophet outranks the awliya together
That may be, if his wonders are many
That may be, as awliya are given knowledge prophets lack
cards.source: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع الأولياء
cards.why: No wali is preferred over any prophet; one prophet is better than all the awliya.

cards.ask: Which of these does the creed affirm?

options.text: The wonders (karamat) of the awliya, soundly reported
Speaking well of the scholars of the salaf
Preferring a wali over a prophet

source: ونؤمن بما جاء من كراماتهم وصح عن الثقات من رواياتهم
لا يذكرون إلا بالجميل
cards.why: He affirms soundly reported karamat and speaking well of the salaf; whoever speaks ill of them is off the path.

cards.title: The Dajjal and 'Isa
cards.ar: ونؤمن بأشراط الساعة من خروج الدجال ونزول عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام من السماء
cards.en: We believe in the signs of the Hour: the coming out of the Dajjal, and the descent of 'Isa son of Maryam from the heaven.

cards.title: The sun and the Beast
cards.ar: ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من مغربها وخروج دابة الأرض من موضعها
cards.en: And we believe in the sun rising from the west, and the Beast of the Earth coming out from its place.

cards.ask: Which signs of the Hour are named here?

options.text: The coming out of the Dajjal
The descent of 'Isa from the heaven
The sun rising from the west
The Beast of the Earth coming out
The flood in the time of Nuh

source: من خروج الدجال ونزول عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام من السماء
ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من مغربها وخروج دابة الأرض من موضعها
cards.why: His four: the Dajjal, 'Isa's descent, the sun from the west, and the Beast of the Earth.

cards.ask: From where will 'Isa son of Maryam come down?
options: From the heaven
From a mountain
From the sea
cards.source: ونزول عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام من السماء
cards.why: Min al-sama': from the heaven.

cards.ask: Complete the statement.
cards.ar: ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من ____
options: مغربها
مشرقها
موضعها
cards.source: ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من مغربها
cards.why: مغربها: the sun rising from where it sets, the west.

cards.title: No soothsayer
cards.ar: ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا ولا من يدعي شيئا يخالف الكتاب والسنة وإجماع الأمة
cards.en: We do not believe a soothsayer (kahin) or a fortune-teller ('arraf), nor anyone who claims something against the Book, the Sunna and the consensus (ijma') of the umma.

cards.ask: Whom do we not believe?

options.text: Anyone who claims what goes against the Book and Sunna
A sound report from trustworthy narrators

cards.source: ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا ولا من يدعي شيئا يخالف الكتاب والسنة وإجماع الأمة
cards.why: Kahin, 'arraf, and anyone claiming against the Book, Sunna and ijma'.

cards.ask: A fortune-teller tells you what will happen to you next year. What does the creed say?
options: We do not believe what he tells
Believe him, if he was right before
Believe him, if he quotes the Quran
cards.source: ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا ولا من يدعي شيئا يخالف الكتاب والسنة وإجماع الأمة
cards.why: We do not believe a kahin or an 'arraf, nor anyone who claims what goes against the Book, the Sunna and the consensus.

cards.ask: Sort: what we believe, and what we do not believe.
source: من خروج الدجال ونزول عيسى ابن مريم
وخروج دابة الأرض من موضعها
ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا
cards.why: The signs of the Hour are believed; soothsayers and fortune-tellers are not.

cards.title: The Jama'a is truth
cards.ar: ونرى الجماعة حقا وصوابا والفرقة زيغا وعذابا
cards.en: We hold the Jama'a (keeping together) to be truth and right, and division to be deviation and torment.

cards.ask: Sort: what the Jama'a is, and what division is.
cards.source: ونرى الجماعة حقا وصوابا والفرقة زيغا وعذابا
cards.why: The Jama'a is haqq and sawab; division is zaygh and 'adhab.

cards.title: One religion
cards.ar: ودين الله في الأرض والسماء واحد وهو دين الإسلام
cards.en: Allah's religion, in the earth and in the heaven, is one: it is the religion of Islam.

cards.title: As Allah says
cards.ar: قال الله تعالى إن الدين عند الله الإسلام وقال تعالى ورضيت لكم الإسلام دينا
cards.en: Allah says: "The religion with Allah is Islam" (3:19), and: "I am pleased with Islam as your religion" (5:3).

cards.ask: Someone says each prophet brought a different religion from Allah. What does the creed say?
options: There is a single religion with Allah: Islam
He is right: one for each prophet's people
He is right: one for the earth, another for heaven
cards.source: ودين الله في الأرض والسماء واحد وهو دين الإسلام
cards.why: Allah's religion in the earth and in the heaven is one: the religion of Islam.

cards.title: Between the extremes
cards.ar: وهو بين الغلو والتقصير وبين التشبيه والتعطيل وبين الجبر والقدر وبين الأمن والإياس
cards.en: It lies between excess and falling short, between likening (tashbih) and stripping away (ta'til), between compulsion (jabr) and denying the decree (qadar), and between feeling safe and despair.

cards.ask: Islam lies between which pairs?
cards.source: وهو بين الغلو والتقصير وبين التشبيه والتعطيل وبين الجبر والقدر وبين الأمن والإياس
cards.why: His four pairs; the religion is the middle of each.

cards.ask: Which word belongs in the gap?
cards.ar: وبين الجبر و____
options: القدر
الإيمان
العدل
cards.source: وبين الجبر والقدر
cards.why: القدر: between jabr and qadar.

cards.ask: Someone says splitting into groups is a mercy for the umma. What does the creed say?
options: Splitting is a swerving that brings suffering
He is right: division is a mercy from Allah for the umma
The Jama'a is one opinion among many
cards.source: والفرقة زيغا وعذابا
cards.why: Al-furqa zaygh wa 'adhab: division is deviation and torment, and the Jama'a is truth.

cards.title: Our religion and creed
cards.ar: فهذا ديننا واعتقادنا ظاهرا وباطنا
cards.en: This is our religion and our creed, outwardly and inwardly.

cards.title: Clear of who opposes it
cards.ar: ونحن براء إلى الله من كل من خالف الذي ذكرناه وبيناه
cards.en: We are clear before Allah of everyone who goes against what we have stated and made clear.

cards.ask: How does al-Tahawi hold this creed?
options: Openly and in his heart alike
Outwardly, for the sake of others
Inwardly, in secret
cards.source: فهذا ديننا واعتقادنا ظاهرا وباطنا
cards.why: Zahiran wa batinan: outwardly and inwardly.

cards.title: Keep us firm
cards.ar: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به
cards.en: We ask Allah to keep us firm on iman and seal our lives with it.

cards.title: Protect us
cards.ar: ويعصمنا من الأهواء المختلفة والآراء المتفرقة والمذاهب الردية
cards.en: And to protect us from the many desires, the scattered opinions and the bad ways.

cards.ask: Which word completes the line?
cards.ar: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان و____ لنا به
options: يختم
يبدأ
يكتب
cards.source: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به
cards.why: يختم: that He seal our lives with iman.

cards.title: The groups he names
cards.ar: مثل المشبهة والمعتزلة والجهمية والجبرية والقدرية وغيرهم من الذين خالفوا السنة والجماعة
cards.en: Such as the Mushabbiha, the Mu'tazila, the Jahmiyya, the Jabriyya and the Qadariyya, and others who went against the Sunna and the Jama'a.

cards.ask: Which groups are named as having gone against the Sunna and the Jama'a?
cards.source: مثل المشبهة والمعتزلة والجهمية والجبرية والقدرية
cards.why: He names the Mushabbiha, Mu'tazila, Jahmiyya, Jabriyya and Qadariyya; he wrote on the way of Abu Hanifa, for Ahl al-Sunna.

cards.title: His last words
cards.ar: وحالفوا الضلالة ونحن منهم براء وهم عندنا ضلال وأردياء وبالله العصمة والتوفيق
cards.en: ...and who allied themselves with misguidance. We are clear of them; to us they are astray and ruined. And with Allah is protection and success.

cards.ask: What is the closing prayer for?
options: Firmness on iman and a good end with it
Wealth and long life
Knowing the secret of the decree before death
cards.source: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به
cards.why: Firmness on iman and a sealing with it, and protection from bad ways.

cards.ask: Put the close in the order the text gives.
steps: This is our religion and creed
We are clear of whoever goes against it
We ask Allah to keep us firm on iman
We ask Him to protect us from bad ways
cards.source: فهذا ديننا واعتقادنا ظاهرا وباطنا ونحن براء إلى الله من كل من خالف الذي ذكرناه وبيناه ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به ويعصمنا من الأهواء المختلفة
cards.why: Our creed; clear of its opponents; a prayer for firmness; a prayer for protection.
